notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.content:
1.0 might suggest this is the first release, but in fact the game has gone thru at least 10 public version bumps since going live on steam as early access.  It should be rock-solid at this point. If it's on your wish-list now is the time to buy!

This version bings small changes, the most visible being new fonts rather than the Arial knock-off that's the engine default up to now.

notes.title: Quality of life changes, all over the place
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202140/1fc7eef640a5bbbda42bd9325e1f92b2f8f6c622.png[/img]
Improved keyboard bindings for gamepad haters

several levels refined to make sure you learn a game mechanic rather than skipping around it

improved subtitles - all narration subtitled, better display, etc

narration now makes both music and FX get quiet so you can actually hear my PERLs** of wisdom. 

re-made start of level 9 so that you can't get stuck 

"improved" in-game feedback system, and now I'm advertising it so that everybody knows to begin the deluge of quick and easy feedback (gulp)

mazes have slightly more clear tells so that wandering randomly is purely optional

other things less easily described, or spoilers. Trust me. I'm not just making this list look longer by padding the number of changes with "other"

** would you like a list of other programming languages I know how to spell? let me know.
